name: 06_fog_rule

memories.title: Never edit core identity mid-session
memories.body: In-session edits to System 0 corrupted the boot stream (the 2025 Aion crash).

memories.title: Boot stream file naming detail
memories.body: Boot streams were named CLAUDE_BOOT_STREAM_vX.txt at the time.

memories.title: Identity editor feature
memories.body: Building an editor for agent identities in Mission Control.

steps.note: The buried but vital lesson is reached through a fresh thread; the ordinary detail is not.
